children: Dunelm is expected to outline a revamped digital offer and increased store investment at its strategy update as part of a drive to boost earnings, Deutsche Bank analysts write. "Profit warnings this year have raised doubts over mid-term margins and the consistency of market share gains but we like the underlying business model," Deutsche Bank says. The German bank raises its rating on the soft furnishing retailer's stock to buy from hold and its target price to 10.50 pounds from 8.50 pounds. Shares are up 3.6% at 8.62 pounds but are down 22% over the year to date. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
